# PDF Vector

> APIs and tools for parsing, extracting, and understanding PDF, Word, Image, and Excel documents to structured markdown with AI. Extract data with JSON Schema, ask questions, and search academic publications.

PDF Vector is a REST API (plus an MCP server and Zapier, Make, and n8n integrations) for document parsing, structured data extraction, document Q&A, and academic paper search. Every API accepts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, and 20+ other formats.

## Docs
- [API reference](https://global.pdfvector.com/api/reference): OpenAPI reference for every endpoint, with request and response schemas
- [MCP server](https://www.pdfvector.com/integrations/mcp): Hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code (OAuth or API key)

## APIs

### Document APIs
- [Document Parse API](https://www.pdfvector.com/document-parse): Convert PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, images, and 20+ file types into clean structured markdown for automated document processing pipelines.
- [Document Ask API](https://www.pdfvector.com/document-ask): Ask natural language questions about any document and get AI-powered answers for automated Q&A workflows.
- [Document Extract API](https://www.pdfvector.com/document-extract): Extract structured JSON data from any document using a custom schema for automated data pipelines.

### Identity APIs
- [Identity Parse API](https://www.pdfvector.com/identity-parse): Parse passports, driver's licenses, and national IDs into structured data for automated identity verification workflows.
- [Identity Ask API](https://www.pdfvector.com/identity-ask): Ask questions about identity documents to verify details, check expiry dates, and validate fields automatically.
- [Identity Extract API](https://www.pdfvector.com/identity-extract): Extract specific fields from passports, licenses, and IDs into structured JSON for automated KYC and compliance workflows.

### Invoice APIs
- [Invoice Parse API](https://www.pdfvector.com/invoice-parse): Extract line items, totals, tax info, and vendor details from invoices for automated accounts payable workflows.
- [Invoice Ask API](https://www.pdfvector.com/invoice-ask): Ask natural language questions about invoices to find amounts, due dates, payment terms, and vendor details.
- [Invoice Extract API](https://www.pdfvector.com/invoice-extract): Extract structured invoice data including line items, totals, and vendor details for automated bookkeeping and reconciliation.

### Bank Statement APIs
- [Bank Statement Parse API](https://www.pdfvector.com/bank-statement-parse): Parse bank statement PDFs to extract transactions, balances, and account details for automated financial workflows.
- [Bank Statement Ask API](https://www.pdfvector.com/bank-statement-ask): Ask natural language questions about bank statements to analyze transactions, totals, and spending patterns.
- [Bank Statement Extract API](https://www.pdfvector.com/bank-statement-extract): Extract transaction data from bank statements into structured JSON for automated reconciliation and financial analysis.

### Academic APIs
- [Academic Search API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-search): Search across PubMed, arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and more in a single API request for automated literature review.
- [Academic Fetch API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-fetch): Fetch paper metadata by DOI, PMID, arXiv ID, or other identifiers for automated bibliography and citation enrichment.
- [Academic Parse API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-parse): Resolve academic paper IDs or provider URLs to public PDFs and convert them into clean markdown for research automation workflows.
- [Academic Find Citations API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-find-citations): Find relevant academic citations for your text using AI-powered semantic matching for automated reference checking.
- [Academic Paper Graph API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-paper-graph): Fetch a paper's citations and references as full publication objects with automatic identifier detection and pagination for citation network analysis.
- [Academic Similar Papers API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-similar-papers): Find papers similar to a seed paper using citation network analysis with similarity scores, PageRank, and optional graph edge data for visualization.
- [Academic Search Grants API](https://www.pdfvector.com/academic-search-grants): Search research grants and funding opportunities across Grants.gov, NIH RePORTER, CORDIS, and UKRI with filtering by deadline, funding amount, and more.

## FAQ
### What file types are supported?
PDF Vector supports 24+ file types including PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, HEIF, TXT, MD, TSV, XML, RTF, HTML, ODT, ODS, ODP, EPUB, BIB, RIS, NBIB, and ENW. All document endpoints work across these formats, so you can use the same API regardless of file type.

### How is PDF Vector battle-tested?
PDF Vector has processed millions of documents across production workloads including financial services, healthcare, legal, and academic research. Our parsing engine is optimized for complex layouts with tables, multi-column text, and mixed content.

### What are credits and how do they work?
Credits are the unit of usage for API calls. Document parse and academic parse cost 1-8 credits per page depending on the model tier (nano to max). Ask and extract operations cost 2-16 credits per page. Invoice, identity, and bank statement endpoints cost 6-10 credits per page to parse and 6-18 to ask or extract. Most other academic endpoints cost fixed credits per request or sentence. Credits reset monthly.

### Is my data secure?
Yes. Files are never stored permanently or used for training, and all data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Files from successful requests are discarded when the request completes; if a request fails on the shared General Instance, the file is kept encrypted for up to 14 days to diagnose the failure, then deleted automatically. The shared General Instance runs in the US. Enterprise dedicated instances run in the location you choose; full document AI instances keep OCR and AI processing inside their data-residency zone (UK, EU, US, Japan, Australia or Asia Pacific).

### What academic databases do you support?
PDF Vector searches across PubMed, arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, ERIC, CrossRef, and Google Scholar. Results from the selected databases are merged into one list, ranked by relevance, and enriched with citation counts and PDF links from Semantic Scholar and Crossref.

### Do you offer enterprise plans?
Yes. Enterprise costs $299/month or $3,289/year (one month free) and includes your first dedicated managed instance with its own 200,000 credits each month, plus 100,000 shared General Instance credits. Additional instances cost $100/month or $1,100/year each; each additional managed instance has its own 200,000 monthly credits. Unused instance credits do not roll over, and annual billing still refreshes credits monthly. Choose Start Enterprise to upgrade in app billing. For custom requirements or a quote, contact team@pdfvector.com.
